notes.title: Trading Cards!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28121063/bde439cf4386846b3977bbbc742504e02d54d444.gif

We're happy to announce that Steam Trading Cards are now available for Manipulated!

Those who collect the whole Manipulated set can then craft their cards into a special game badge that is displayed on their Steam profile. Additionally, this badge also gives players special bonus items, including emoticons, profile backgrounds, and even coupons.

Badges:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28121063/a5b6bc628b6d24eda27845b9af36a14d82259944.png

Backgrounds:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28121063/7dfe0006bb48c09d9300a91e9abdbe949b4d7763.png

Emoticons:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28121063/95209f0898f8048e0581e3643014dcf046533e68.png

Happy collecting!


More information about Steam Trading Cards:
Steam Trading Cards page
